correctness.rationale: The six exact read counts equal a looped multigraph edge inventory. On at most three vertices, the Euler connectivity criterion suffices because there cannot be four odd vertices. The proof explicitly classifies loop-free skeleton reversal orbits for zero, one, two and three nonloop edge types, then handles loop distribution only at singly visited vertices. Every disjoint singleton type contributes one rational geometric series. Direct independent enumeration of all 797160 ternary words of lengths 1..12 agrees with every profile predicate and both count formulas, including the n=1 exception. Full all-length proof is mathematical, not inferred from the finite experiment.

value.rationale: Exact singleton reconstruction from a six-count unstranded ternary digram-composition observation is a naturally motivated next nonbinary reconstruction invariant. Its three-letter path-support phenomenon cannot occur in binary readings; the graph classification makes an exact O(1)-time decision possible from the six observed counts, and the rational census plus sharp profile-scarcity asymptotic answer how frequently unique observations occur. The result is a complete infinite-length classification, not a table or routine numerical increment. It does not assert any noisy-channel benefit.
